name: zmodel_material_add_cycle_texture
description: zModel_Material::AddCycleTexture appends a texture-directory entry to a cycle material's frame table.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this isolated material helper; tier S work is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x481100 validate cycle flag bit 0x0400 check, loading material->cycle, rejecting a null frameTable, rejecting frameWriteCount >= frameCount, storing the texture entry at frameTable[frameWriteCount], incrementing frameWriteCount, and returning 1 on success or 0 on rejection.

Native smoke zmodel_material_defaults_and_find_smoke verifies AddCycleTexture succeeds on a cycle-enabled material, stores the texture entry, increments frameWriteCount, and rejects a non-cycle material.
